summary: This Form 8-K reports a routine quarterly dividend declaration on Triumph Financial's Series C Preferred Stock. The board declared a cash dividend of $17.81 per preferred share ($0.44525 per depositary share), payable June 30, 2026, to holders of record June 15, 2026. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, spin-off, restructuring, or other special situation is announced. This is a standard capital return event with no structural or strategic significance beyond ordinary course dividend payments.
